Features
- Images: Show Image Job Status
- Remove session hosts: When empty (drain first)
- VM size: Browse... picker (search, filters, why a size doesn't fit, quota)
- WDOT: custom download URL (your own copy / fork)
- WDOT: defaults in the config file and Config Editor (Images.Wdot)
- Tasks tab: scheduled Clean Snapshots / Clean Image Versions, shared through the config folder
